_help: Jessie & The Revolvers releases, newest first. The first one is the featured release everywhere on the site. 'spotify' is the bit after open.spotify.com/ and powers the on-page player. Leave a link empty to hide that button. Artwork is optional: save it as assets/img/releases/<slug>.jpg (square, 1000px or bigger) and it appears on its own.

releases.title: Long Gone
releases.blurb: Lyrics from Jessie's notes over a practice-room jam. Softer vocals up against heavy 90s guitars.

releases.title: Self Obsessed
releases.blurb: Where it started. Written in Jessie's bedroom, blunt and punchy on purpose.

_videos_help: Add videos as { "title": "Long Gone", "note": "Official video", "url": "https://youtu.be/...", "thumb": "assets/img/video-1.jpg" }. The Watch section stays hidden until at least one has a url.
